items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: You said this was your goal back then, but that was forty – thirty-five, forty years ago, so you’re still going. Do you have any goals that you want to accomplish these days?

You know, I finally got to the – you know I wrote for Sarah Vaughn, I wrote for um, Ella Fitzgerald. I did over sixty orchestrations for Ella Fitzgerald, plus a whole album she did with me and my band. Um, I had written for Nancy Wilson, I did over twenty – over twenty-five sides with Nancy. I had her first hit. I had her first hit.
